profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
I am a experienced and self motivated seasoned Systems Engineer with more than 14 years of experience working in client services, support and operations area, within services and telecommunications companies. 

I have had actively participated in different kinds of projects such as web application development, software development, automation of processes, design, and implementation of databases ( MySQL and Oracle), and Dashboards.

My expertise as a solution-oriented and resourceful employee has generated added value and initiatives to optimize processes, improved the quality of service, minimized response's time and decrease cost. 

I am dedicated to constant innovation, and I enable to assuming responsibilities to achieve goals in a fast-paced environment. I have excellent interpersonal communication skills and the ability to accomplish goals while monitoring tasks and taking prevented and corrective actions.

DATABASE HIGHLIGHT QUALIFICATION
• Exceptional experience on working with MySQL Database
• 4+ years of highly experienced on MySQL Database under 5.6 version.
• Amazing ability to create Data Models from user requirements.
• Designed, development, and improvement MySQL Databases using appropriately all database's ob-
jects to support and develop enterprise projects basis on a previous requirements analysis.
• Strong experience in MySQL writing complex SQL queries, stored procedures, cursors, triggers and
functions.
• Query optimization with respect to its performance and SQL written Syntax.
• Ensured data integrity and data errors detection and misuse.
• Experience in cloud-based database systems such as Amazon RDS and Digital Ocean.

PHP DEVELOPER HIGHLIGHT QUALIFICATION

• Developed Full-Stack Web Application using PHP, Laravel, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript.
• Performed CRUD operations using Laravel over MySQL database.
• Implemented Bootstrap and CSS to create user friendly webpages.
• Utilized DevOps methodology to work with team environments.
• Implemented Unit-Testing through PHPUnit.
• Implemented custom AJAX to transfer JSON data.

positions.description:

positions.title: SOFTWARE DEVELOPER ENGINEER AT TEST
positions.description:
* Developed full-stack application using the Front and Back-end technologies such as 
     HTML, Bootstrap, JavaScript, Angular, Hibernate, and Spring ORM.
* Used RDS service to manage SQL databases.
* Designed, development, and implemented databases related with assigned projects. 
* Performed CRUD operations, using JDBC, DAO, Hibernate, JPA over Postgres Database.
* Implemented Bootstrap and CSS to style to create user-friendly webpages.
* Utilized DevOps methodology to work within team environments.Utilized Cloud services like Amazon EC2 and DigitalOcean to host web applications.
* Implemented Unit-Testing through Junit and Mockito for Java applications.
* Designed development, implementation, and improvement MySQL and Postgres Databases using appropriately all database's objects (tables, keys, indexes, views, triggers, stored procedures, functions) to support and develop enterprise projects basis on a previous requirements analysis.
* Implemented custom AJAX to transfer JSON data between Web Service

positions.title: Activation Specialist
positions.description:
PHP DEVELOPER

* Full-Stack PHP Developer for various in-house organizational projects.
* Automated process through out PHP’s scripts.
* Improved Web-based applications adding new features.
* Performed database design, development, implementation and administration activities.
* Development ad hoc and scheduled reports to provides information to perform daily basis task.
* Designed front-end using PHP, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript ,and JQuery to a improve user experience.

DATABASE DEVELOPER

* Designed database architecture for different organizational projects.
* MySQL Database Sync installed in different servers.
* MySQL to ORACLE database migration (migrate a MySql database to Oracle).
* Performed database design, development, and implementation and administration activities.
* Development of Data Flow Diagrams, Entity Relationship Diagrams and Data Structure Diagrams.
* Development ad hoc and scheduled reports to provides information to perform daily basis task.
* Write Complex SQL queries, store procedures, cursors, triggers, and functions.
* Query optimization with respect to its performance and SQL written Syntax.
* Automated process design, optimize, program and implementation of recurrent regular processes.
* MySQL Database and PHP program integration.
* Guarante availability of the linux server services hrough out the control of the variables which could affect the correct functioning of this.

ADMINISTRATIVE TASKS

* Followed up to the service level agreements of services providers.
* Management and contract supervision of providers services such as documentary management, carriers, storage and transportation of documents.
* Followed up to the key performance indicators of services providers.
* Payment authorization for service providers through out verification and reconciliation of invoices.
* Negotiate the agreements to modify the contracts of service providers.

Nationwide application support for PAL application.

projects.title: Tablero De Control Implementado En El Area de Marketing De Una Video Tienda De Alquiler
projects.description:
Se crea un tablero de control en el cual se presente el estado de los indicadores del área de Marketing de la Video tienda, con el fin de facilitar la toma de decisiones a los ejecutivos.

Alguno de los objetivos perseguidos son:

* Automatizar el proceso para realizar el seguimiento de los abonados y sus transacciones.

* Generar un cuadro para comparar las metas propuestas y alcanzadas por el personal administrativo de la Video tienda.

*Calcular los indicadores para visualizar la proporción de nuevos abonados y retirados.
